היסטוריון ויועץ למוזיאונים ואתרי מורשת,: A historian and museum and heritage-site consultant, guiding in Israel and overseas for nearly 40 years.
מרצה ויועץ אקדמי לפרוייקטים היסטוריים-אר: Dr Eyal Miron is an experienced historian, lecturer and academic consultant on historical and archaeological projects, specialising in museums and heritage sites. He has written and edited dozens of books on history and archaeology, and taught in the Department of Land of Israel Studies and Archaeology at Bar-Ilan University and the Department of Jewish Thought at the Hebrew University. He has guided in Israel and overseas for nearly 40 years, teaches at academic institutions and on the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cadet course, and has trained thousands of tour guides.
מורה דרך מוסמך מטעם משרד התיירות בעלים ש: A guide licensed by Israel's Ministry of Tourism, owner of Beit Bagina hotel and restaurant in Jerusalem, with 30 years of experience in tourism.
חוקרת ומרצה לארכיאולוגיה והיסטוריה קלאסי: Researcher and lecturer in archaeology and classical history
ד\"ר רוית פרבר היא מרצה וחוקרת בתחום האר: Dr Ravit Farber researches and lectures on archaeology and classical history, specialising in Hellenistic and ancient Greece and the Roman and Byzantine periods. She studied at University College London and in the Department of Land of Israel Studies at Bar-Ilan University. Her doctoral work examined early Christianity and knowledge of ancient Greek. Alongside her research, she works as a tour guide and lecturer at institutions including Yad Ben-Zvi, the Avshalom Institute, the Israeli Institute of Archaeology's Tagliyot programme and tour-guide training courses.
מורה דרך ומומחה בתיירות את אהבתי לארץ יש: My love of Israel and its neighbours began as a member and leader of the HaMahanot HaOlim youth movement. In the kibbutz movement, I led local-history groups and tours to Sinai. I was among the first guides to visit Egypt in 1982 as guests of a leading Cairo travel company, but chose to focus on guiding in Israel. I qualified as a national tour guide in 1986. In 1995, I began coordinating tour-guide courses at the School of Tourism, initially a government company and later part of the University of Haifa.
המדריכים בטיולי העולם העתיק נבחרים בקפדנ: Our guides are carefully selected for their experience, personality and knowledge of ancient history, architecture, art history and religions, as well as their attention to travellers' needs. They share their knowledge through engaging anecdotes and stories, with a sense of humour.
